raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

With rejection sampling at topk 1 (`--speculative-use-rejection-sampling`), the multi-layer EAGLE draft's per-step draft-extend CUDA graphs computed a softmax and a top-1 that the worker then discarded: it re-sampled each step's proposal eagerly with a softmax over the full draft vocabulary. Only the single combined-graph runner drew the proposal inside its graph. Per-step graphs are what a multi-layer draft runs on wherever the combined graph is not used (for example the triton backend), so each draft step paid an extra eager softmax and sampling pass.

## Modifications

- Each step's graph now draws its proposal (`speculative/multi_layer_eagle_draft_extend_cuda_graph_runner.py`): the runner allocates the temperature and q buffers whenever its graphs may capture the proposal.
- The worker (`speculative/multi_layer_eagle_worker_v2.py`) keys the eager resample and the q snapshot on a read-only `samples_in_graph` property derived from those buffers. Rotation and the per-step top-k clones stay keyed on `rotates_in_graph`. On NPU the runner opts out and keeps the worker-side proposal.
- The proposal keeps its distribution: q = softmax(logits / T) and X ~ q, with q handed to the verify as drawn. Under `--enable-deterministic-inference` the graphs draw the seeded proposal, keyed by the same seeds, positions and draft steps as the worker's eager draw.

Tests:
- CUDA (SM90), `test/registered/kernels/ops/speculative/test_multi_layer_eagle_draft_proposal_graphs.py`: per-step graphs that draw in graph give the same proposals as the eager path over the same q, and seeded in-graph draws repeat bitwise across replays and equal the eager seeded draw.
- CPU, `test/registered/unit/spec/test_multi_layer_eagle_draft_extend_sampling.py`: which path samples (graph or worker) for each runner and flag combination, the NPU opt-out, the q handed to the verify, and the seeded equivalence.

## Accuracy Tests

Determinism, SM90, main `669292bacc` with this PR and the other open unified-memory PRs applied: `thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small`, TP 8, `--attention-backend triton`, `--speculative-algorithm EAGLE --speculative-draft-model-path thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small --enable-multi-layer-eagle --speculative-num-steps 8 --speculative-eagle-topk 1 --speculative-num-draft-tokens 9 --speculative-use-rejection-sampling`, `--enable-deterministic-inference`, temperature 1.0 with a fixed `sampling_seed`. Repeated requests decode identically on the default pool and with `--enable-unified-memory`, for single requests and for requests sharing a prefix.

GSM8K, before upstream's unified-memory rewrite (`python -m sglang.test.run_eval`, all 1314 test questions, 5-shot, greedy; median accept length from the scheduler logs), same model and draft flags on `--attention-backend fa4`, CUDA graphs on:

| pool | GSM8K, before / after | accept length, before / after |
|---|---|---|
| default | 0.823 / 0.825 | 3.42 / 3.48 |
| `--enable-unified-memory` | 0.835 / 0.833 | 3.46 / 3.46 |

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Same model and draft flags, radix cache, overlap scheduler, CUDA graphs on. Throughput before and after this PR; the number in parentheses is the larger of the repeat-run and same-config spread.

| main | attention backend | pool | 100 requests of 512 input / 4096 output tokens, concurrency 128 | 192 requests sharing a 4096-token prefix + 128 tokens, 2048 output tokens, concurrency 192 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `259f0131c9` | fa4 | default | -1.2% (1.6) | +0.8% (1.8) |
| `259f0131c9` | fa4 | `--enable-unified-memory` | +8.7% (1.6) | +7.5% (1.8) |
| `efdcb420c7`, with #45668 | triton, `--max-running-requests 14` | default | +3.0% (0.6) | +4.6% (3.2) |
| `efdcb420c7`, with #45668 | triton, `--max-running-requests 11` | default | +6.1% (6.9) | +3.3% (2.7) |
| `efdcb420c7`, with #45668 | triton, `--max-running-requests 11` | `--enable-unified-memory` | +2.2% (4.5) | +1.8% (3.4) |

On unified fa4 mean TTFT also fell 8.3% and 7.1% and mean ITL 7.4% and 7.0%, with accept length unchanged (3.94 before, 3.95 after). The request cap is unchanged.

On triton (two runs per build and pool) the unified gain is positive in all four before/after pairs but inside the spread, so these runs cannot tell it from zero. At `--max-running-requests 11`, accept length shows no change beyond the spread: unified -2.6% (8.1) and +0.3% (2.1), default +0.4% (7.9) and +0.5% (3.5), so a small fall on the first load is not excluded. An earlier single-run comparison on `76d5b3ce02` with #45668 read +3.9% and +6.1% on the default pool and -1.3% and -1.9% on unified; these runs do not explain that difference.

To take run-to-run differences out, the first load also ran with `--enable-deterministic-inference --context-length 8192 --max-running-requests 11` and one fixed seed, two runs per build and pool. Every run did identical work: 205,228 tokens and 65,617 verify steps, with text, output ids, verify counts and accept histograms matching on all 100 requests across builds and pools. Throughput rose 3.12% on the default pool and 3.18% on unified, with repeats within 0.1%, and the decode step fell from about 67.3 ms to 65.1 ms on both. This shows the saving reaches both pools, not the gain to expect in normal serving: this mode runs a slower step (67 ms against 37 to 41 ms), uses a seeded draw instead of the graph's generator, and covers one load and one seed.

Memory: with rejection sampling at topk 1 and CUDA graphs on, per-step graphs now reserve the proposal buffer the combined graph already reserves, largest captured batch x draft steps x vocabulary size x 4 bytes per GPU. For Inkling-Small at 11 requests that is 71 MB, and free GPU memory after capture fell by 0.06 to 0.08 GB, with the same KV capacity and request cap. At a batch of 128 with this vocabulary it would be 823 MB per GPU (calculated, not measured).

Where this applies: on fa4 the default pool runs the combined draft graph, which already sampled in the graph, so it is unchanged. Unified fa4 gains here only because main falls back to per-step graphs there; #46386 moves it to the combined graph, so with that PR the fa4 row no longer adds, and this PR's lasting effect is on runs that keep per-step graphs, such as triton above. Upstream's JIT softmax for the sampler applies on SM100-class GPUs only, so it does not affect these SM90 numbers; the gain on SM100 was not measured.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+"""Multi-layer EAGLE's draft proposal inside per-step CUDA graphs.
+
+MultiLayerEagleMultiStepDraftExtendCudaGraphRunner captures one graph per draft
+step and capture size into a shared memory pool, steps in reverse, and replays
+them forward. Under rejection sampling each graph runs the production
+_sample_draft_proposal: q = softmax(logits / T) into the step's draft_probs
+slot, then X ~ q, seeded under deterministic inference. Here the model forward
+is a copy of staged logits; the rest of the graph body is production code.
+"""
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=30, stage="base-b-kernel-unit", runner_config="1-gpu-small")
+
+import math
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+from sglang.srt.speculative.multi_layer_eagle_draft_extend_cuda_graph_runner import (
+    MultiLayerEagleDraftExtendCudaGraphRunner,
+    MultiLayerEagleMultiStepDraftExtendCudaGraphRunner,
+)
+from sglang.srt.speculative.spec_utils import fast_sample
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+NUM_STEPS = 3
+CAPTURE_BS = (2, 4)
+MAX_BS = max(CAPTURE_BS)
+# Draft-extend window per request (num_steps + 1 rows, no front rows).
+WIDTH = NUM_STEPS + 1
+UNTOUCHED = -1.0
+
+
+def _bucket(raw_bs: int) -> int:
+    return min(bs for bs in CAPTURE_BS if bs >= raw_bs)
+
+
+class _PerStepProposalGraphs:
+    """The per-step runner's capture pattern around the production proposal."""
+
+    def __init__(self, vocab: int, *, prune: bool, gumbel: bool, seeded=False):
+        self.prune = prune
+        device = "cuda"
+        rows = MAX_BS if prune else MAX_BS * WIDTH
+        # The model's lm_head output for the replayed step.
+        self.logits = torch.zeros((rows, vocab), dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+        self.buffers = SimpleNamespace(
+            select_index=torch.zeros((MAX_BS,), dtype=torch.int64, device=device),

+    the new token at its selected row."""
+    for i in range(extend_seq_lens.shape[0]):

+        window = input_ids[start : start + length]
+        window[:-1] = window[1:].clone()

+def _murmur_hash32(seeds, positions, cols):
+    """murmur_hash32's contract: one uint32 per (row seed, row position, column)."""
+    keys = (

+        + positions.to(torch.int64)[:, None] * 7919

+class _GraphBoundary:
+    """Capture records the step function and replay re-runs it. Per-step
+    graphs share one memory pool, so a replay writes its top-k into storage
+    the next step's replay overwrites."""

+    def __init__(self, pool):

+            return out

+            slot[: value.shape[0]].copy_(value)

+        temperatures = torch.tensor([[0.7], [1.0], [1.3], [0.9]][:raw_bs])
+        worker.calls.clear()
+        out = _decode_round(
+            worker,
+            tokens=tokens,
+            accept_lens=accept_lens,
+            temperatures=temperatures,
+            sampling_seed=sampling_seed,
+        )
+        return out, temperatures, list(worker.calls)
+
+    def _check_chain(self, out, calls, raw_bs=3):
+        """Each step's returned proposal is the token the next step reads."""
+        self.assertEqual([step for step, _, _ in calls], list(range(NUM_STEPS)))
+        self.assertEqual(out.topk_index.shape, (raw_bs, NUM_STEPS))
+        for step in range(NUM_STEPS - 1):
+            self.assertEqual(
+                calls[step + 1][1][:raw_bs].tolist(), out.topk_index[:, step].tolist()
+            )
+
+    def _check_proposal(self, worker, out, temperatures, calls, raw_bs=3):
+        """q is softmax(logits / T) per step, X ~ q, q(X) = q[X], and q is the
+        worker's own copy, not the runner's buffer."""
+        cgr = worker.cuda_graph_runner_for_draft_extend
+        self.assertEqual(out.draft_probs.shape, (raw_bs, NUM_STEPS, VOCAB))
+        for step, _, logits in calls:
+            expected = torch.softmax(logits[:raw_bs] / temperatures, dim=-1)
+            torch.testing.assert_close(out.draft_probs[:, step], expected)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(
+            out.topk_p,
+            out.draft_probs.gather(2, out.topk_index.unsqueeze(-1)).squeeze(-1),
+            rtol=0,
+            atol=0,
+        )
+        if cgr.buffers.draft_probs is not None:
+            self.assertNotEqual(
+                out.draft_probs.data_ptr(), cgr.buffers.draft_probs.data_ptr()
+            )
+
+    def _check_survives_next_round(self, worker, out):
+        held = (out.topk_index.clone(), out.topk_p.clone(), out.draft_probs.clone())
+        self._round(worker)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(out.topk_index, held[0], rtol=0, atol=0)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(out.topk_p, held[1], rtol=0, atol=0)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(out.draft_probs, held[2], rtol=0, atol=0)
+
+    def test_graphs_without_proposal_resample_in_the_worker(self):
+        """(samples_in_graph, rotates_in_graph) = (False, False)."""
+        worker = _make_worker(_PerStepGraphsWithoutProposal, rejection_sampling=True)
+        cgr = worker.cuda_graph_runner_for_draft_extend
+        self.assertFalse(cgr.samples_in_graph)
+        self.assertIsNone(cgr.buffers.draft_probs)
+        out, temperatures, calls = self._round(worker)
+        self.assertEqual(self.eager_proposal.call_count, NUM_STEPS)
+        self._check_chain(out, calls)
+        self._check_proposal(worker, out, temperatures, calls)
+        self._check_survives_next_round(worker, out)
+
+    def test_per_step_graphs_sample_in_graph(self):
+        """(True, False): the worker rotates and clones each step's top-k."""
+        worker = _make_worker(_PerStepGraphs, rejection_sampling=True)
+        cgr = worker.cuda_graph_runner_for_draft_extend
+        self.assertTrue(cgr.samples_in_graph)
+        self.assertFalse(cgr.rotates_in_graph)
+        out, temperatures, calls = self._round(worker)

+        self._check_survives_next_round(worker, out)
+

+    def test_seeded_proposals_match_the_worker_side_draws(self):
+        """Under deterministic inference the per-step graphs draw the seeded
+        proposal the worker draws when its graphs cannot: the same seeds,
+        positions and draft steps, so the same tokens whatever the RNG state."""
+        seeds = torch.tensor([11, 22, 33])
+        hashed = MagicMock(side_effect=_murmur_hash32)
+        drawn = {}
+        with patch("sglang.kernels.ops.sampling.murmur_hash.murmur_hash32", hashed):
+            for runner_cls in (_PerStepGraphsWithoutProposal, _PerStepGraphs):
+                worker = _make_worker(
+                    runner_cls, rejection_sampling=True, deterministic=True
+                )
+                cgr = worker.cuda_graph_runner_for_draft_extend
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    cgr.buffers.sampling_seed is not None, cgr.samples_in_graph
+                )
+                rounds = []
+                for rng_seed in (1, 2):
+                    torch.manual_seed(rng_seed)
+                    hashed.reset_mock()
+                    out, temperatures, calls = self._round(
+                        worker,
+                        sampling_seed=seeds,
+                        generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(0),
+                    )
+                    self._check_chain(out, calls)
+                    self._check_proposal(worker, out, temperatures, calls)
+                    rounds.append(out.topk_index)
+                    # Each step's draw is keyed by the request's seed and
+                    # position, and by the step through the hash columns.
+                    self.assertEqual(hashed.call_count, NUM_STEPS)
+                    for step, call in enumerate(hashed.call_args_list):
+                        salted, positions, cols = call.args
+                        self.assertEqual(
+                            (salted[:3].to(torch.int64) - seeds).unique().numel(), 1
+                        )
+                        self.assertEqual(positions[:3].tolist(), [16, 16, 16])
+                        self.assertEqual(cols[0].item(), step * VOCAB)
+                self.assertEqual(rounds[0].tolist(), rounds[1].tolist())
+                drawn[runner_cls] = rounds[0]
+        self.assertEqual(self.eager_proposal.call_count, 2 * NUM_STEPS)
+        self.assertEqual(
+            drawn[_PerStepGraphsWithoutProposal].tolist(),
+            drawn[_PerStepGraphs].tolist(),
+        )
+
+    def test_rejection_sampling_off_takes_the_top_token(self):
